title: Mumbo's Horse
description: Retextures donkeys when given a custom saddle
body:
Changes the texture of the Donkey to Mumbo's Sports Horse from Season 8 of Hermitcraft when applying a custom saddle obtained using the below command.

Saddle Give Command:

```/give @s minecraft:saddle[equippable={slot:saddle,asset_id:"furihorse"},custom_name="Furihorse Saddle"]```
